title: Parergon (The Frame Is Not Drawn by You)
summary: The native focus ring is the picture frame, and the browser's :focus-visible heuristic decides who gets to see it.
mechanism: CSS :focus-visible plus the unstyled user-agent focus outline: the frame appears for keyboard arrivals and is withheld from pointer clicks, a verdict the page reads via matches(':focus-visible') but cannot forge.
references: Jacques Derrida, The Truth in Painting / Le parergon (1978)
Immanuel Kant, Critique of the Power of Judgment (1790)
